purpose: A lab management module within the UNILIS learning management system for managing student practicals, lab sessions, experiments, report submissions, IoT device integration (RFID/CO2), QR-based authentication, blockchain-based audit trails, and complete lab asset/inventory management with strict academic integrity workflow enforcement.

architecture.pattern: Front Controller MVC (custom PHP, no framework)
request_lifecycle: 1. Apache mod_rewrite in .htaccess: All non-file/non-directory requests rewritten to index.php?url=<path>

2. index.php: Loads environment config (app.php or app_production.php), database config, roles config, and helper utilities. Checks session authentication. If unauthenticated and not accessing auth/qr routes, redirects to landing.html.

3. routes/web.php: Parses URL segments into controller name, method, and optional parameter. Maps controller name (e.g., 'practicals') to controller class (e.g., 'PracticalController') using a hardcoded associative array. Instantiates the controller and calls the method with the parameter.
4. Controller: Loads models and includes via require_once, performs business logic, renders views using renderView() helper.
5. Model: PDO-based database queries using a singleton getDB() function.
6. View: Procedural PHP templates rendered via renderView() which includes layouts/header.php, the template, and layouts/footer.php.
architecture.environment_detection: index.php checks if $_SERVER['HTTP_HOST'] contains 'unilis.jhubafrica.com' to determine production vs development mode and loads corresponding config files.

auth_methods.description: Login via reg_number + password (password_verify with bcrypt). NOTE: Password login does NOT qualify as attendance verification in the strict workflow.
Login via pre-registered biometric hash (SHA-256 with BIOMETRIC_SALT). Qualifies as physical presence verification.
Login via QR token that encodes sessionId + timestamp, verified with HMAC-SHA256 using QR_SECRET_KEY (5 min expiry). Legacy method.
Login via RFID UID, looked up in rfid_cards table linked to users. Qualifies as physical presence verification.
Login via technician-generated confirmation code linked to lab_sessions (8-hour validity).

security_features: Session timeout check (SESSION_LIFETIME, default 3600s) with last_activity tracking
Multi-factor authentication support (initiateMultiFactor, verifyMultiFactor) for admin/lecturer roles
QR token HMAC signing with 5-minute expiry

controllers.name: WorkflowController
controllers.description: Handles all academic-integrity workflow transitions including attendance verification (physical presence only), practical start/complete, datasheet generation/submission, report writing/submission, QR-based datasheet verification, and blockchain audit.

methods.status: GET /workflow/status/{practical_id} - JSON endpoint returning current workflow state, progress percentage, and availability flags
methods.verifyAttendance: POST /workflow/verify-attendance - Verifies attendance via RFID, Biometric, Dynamic QR, Technician Code, or NFC. Rejects PASSWORD/EMAIL methods. Two-step transition: Awaiting Verification → Verified.
methods.startPractical: POST /workflow/start-practical - Starts practical ONLY if in 'Verified' state, practical time has started, and verification is not expired. Auto-transitions through 'Ready To Start'.
methods.completePractical: POST /workflow/complete-practical - Marks practical as completed, triggers datasheet generation readiness.
methods.generateDatasheet: POST /workflow/generate-datasheet - Auto-generates datasheet ONLY after practical completion. Creates HTML+blockchain hash+QR token record.
methods.submitDatasheet: POST /workflow/submit-datasheet - Submits datasheet, creates blockchain record, locks datasheet, opens report writing.
methods.openReportWriting: POST /workflow/open-report-writing - Creates report record linked to datasheet, transitions to report writing state.
methods.verifyDatasheet: GET /workflow/verify-datasheet/{token} - Verifies a datasheet by its QR token. Checks expiry, revocation, blockchain hash integrity.
methods.dashboard: GET /workflow/dashboard/{practical_id} - Renders the student-facing practical workflow dashboard with full status display.
methods.verifyView: GET /workflow/verify-view/{practical_id} - Renders the attendance verification page for a practical.
methods.datasheetVerifyPage: GET /datasheets/verify/{token} - Renders the datasheet verification result page for QR scan.
methods.labQR: GET /workflow/lab-qr?lab_id=&practical_id= - JSON endpoint returning current dynamic QR code for lab display.
methods.blockchainAudit: GET /workflow/blockchain-audit/{datasheet_id} - Returns full blockchain audit trail for a datasheet (lecturer/admin only).
methods.checkTamper: POST /workflow/check-tamper - Compares current PDF hash against blockchain record to detect tampering.
methods.pendingVerifications: GET /workflow/pending-verifications/{practical_id} - Returns all student verifications for a practical (lecturer/admin only).
methods.grade: POST /workflow/grade - Lecturer grades a student's practical (lecturer/admin only).

academic_integrity_workflow.description: Core state machine enforcing strict practical workflow with physical-presence-only attendance verification.
critical_rules: Datasheet is never generated before practical starts
Only RFID/Biometric/DynamicQR/TechnicianCode/NFC qualify as physical presence verification
Password/email login never counts as attendance verification
Report writing locked until datasheet is submitted and verified
All datasheets contain QR verification + blockchain linkage
Attendance verification window: configurable minutes before/after practical start (default: opens 30 min before, closes 20 min after)
Practical can only start when time >= scheduled start time AND verification is active
background_checks_for_start: Check student is scheduled for this practical
Check verification method is physical (not password)

datasheet_system.description_v2: Academic integrity datasheet system - auto-generated ONLY after practical completion. Each datasheet contains student info, practical info, verification method & time, lab/session info, measurements, observations, calculations, results, practical start & end times, QR verification code, blockchain audit hash, and digital signature for tamper evidence.
key_features: Datasheet generation forcibly blocked before practical completion (checks workflow_status === 'Practical Completed')
Each datasheet stored as HTML file with SHA-256 hash
Unique QR token (64 hex chars) generated per datasheet with 365-day expiry
Blockchain hash computed from all datasheet data + timestamp for immutability
Verification endpoint accepts QR token and returns full datasheet metadata with blockchain proof
QR token statuses: active → used → expired/revoked
Datasheet submission statuses: generated → submitted → verified
Footer imprint: 'Generated by UNILIS SmartLabs', Datasheet ID, Attendance Verification method, Blockchain Hash
datasheet_system.verifyByToken: Public verification endpoint that checks token existence, expiry, revocation status, blockchain hash integrity, and marks QR as used on successful verification.

legacy_datasheet_system.description: Chemical safety datasheet management with PDF generation (separate from academic integrity datasheets)
legacy_datasheet_system.workflow: Technicians upload chemical datasheets → stored in database → searchable/printable → PDF generation for download

blockchain_audit_service.description: Blockchain-based audit trail for datasheet submissions. Each submission creates an immutable block in the blockchain_blocks table chained via previous_hash pointers.

methods.storeDatasheetHash: Creates a block with block_index, previous_hash, block_data (event + datasheet_id + pdf_hash + timestamp), and computed SHA-256 hash. Returns block_id, index, hash.
methods.verifyHash: Looks up a hash in the blockchain and re-verifies chain integrity up to that block.
methods.getAuditTrail: Returns all blockchain blocks linked to a datasheet_id.
methods.detectTampering: Compares a current PDF hash against the stored blockchain record. Returns tampered=true with original_hash and current_hash if mismatch detected.

blockchain_audit_service.chain_verification: verifyChainIntegrity iterates all blocks from genesis to target index, verifying previous_hash pointers form an unbroken chain.

dynamic_qr_service.description: Dynamic QR codes for attendance verification displayed on laboratory screens. Refresh every 15 seconds, single-use, nonce-based anti-replay.
security_features: Auto-refresh every 15 seconds on lab display
Single-use nonce prevents screenshot reuse (stored in file-based cache + audit_logs)
HMAC-SHA256 digital signature with lab-specific derived secret key
Nonce cleaned up after expiration via cleanupExpiredNonces()
Base64-encoded JSON payload for QR rendering
dynamic_qr_service.workflow: Lab screen displays rotating QR → Student scans → verifyQRPayload checks signature, expiration, nonce uniqueness → marks nonce as used → verification logged → attendance approved

practical_workflow.description: Full academic integrity workflow enforced by WorkflowEngine state machine
steps: 1. Lecturer/Admin creates practical: Sets title, objective, theory, description, lab, course code, date/time, max students, equipment, chemicals, procedure (JSON), observations table, safety notes, results/calculations templates, verification window settings
2. Publish practical: Status changes from 'draft' to 'published'
3. Lab availability check: Max 3 practicals per lab per day, time slot conflict prevention
4. Session initialization: student_practical_sessions record created with 'Scheduled' status

5. Attendance verification window opens (configurable, default 30 min before start): Student must verify via RFID, Biometric, Dynamic QR (lab display, 15-sec refresh), Technician Code, or NFC. Password login REJECTED. Two-step: Awaiting Verification → Verified. Verification expires after configurable timeout (default 30 min).
6. Ready To Start: System checks scheduled start time has been reached and verification is still valid
7. Practical In Progress: Student executes practical via tabbed interface (aims, materials, procedure, data tables, calculations, results, conclusion) with auto-save
8. Practical Completed: Student marks practical as complete
9. Datasheet Auto-Generated: DatasheetGenerator creates HTML datasheet with student info, verification proof, measurements, blockchain hash, QR token. Force-blocked if practical not yet completed.
10. Datasheet Submitted: Datasheet locked, blockchain block created (BlockchainAuditService::storeDatasheetHash), QR token activated. Chain includes previous_hash pointer for integrity.
11. Report Writing Open: New report record created in 'reports' table linked to datasheet
12. Report Submitted: Student submits final report
13. Grading: Lecturer grades the report with grade and feedback. Only lecturer/admin role allowed.
14. Blockchain audit: All datasheet activities logged to blockchain_blocks table for tamper-proof audit trail. Tamper detection available via checkTamper endpoint.

rfid.description: RFID card registration and login system. Qualifies as physical presence verification for strict workflow.
rfid.implementation: rfid_cards table links UID hex strings to user accounts. One card per student (upsert logic). Auth::loginByRFID() and Auth::registerRFIDCard() handle the flow.

qr_code.description_v2: Two QR systems: (1) Legacy static QR for session login via HMAC, (2) Dynamic QR for attendance verification with 15-second refresh, nonce-based anti-replay, HMAC-SHA256 digital signature.
qr_code.legacy: Auth::generateQR() creates HMAC-SHA256 signed tokens with session ID and timestamp. Auth::verifyQR() validates signature and expiry (5 min). QRCodeGenerator.php class provides rendering.
qr_code.dynamic: DynamicQRService::generateQRPayload() creates payload with lab_id, session_id, practical_id, timestamp, expiration, nonce, digital signature. Base64 encoded for display. verifyQRPayload() checks all fields, signature, and nonce uniqueness before approving. Single-use prevents screenshot reuse.
